verification_instructions: Verify by checking that all color values are updated correctly in CSS and HTML files using grep. Ensure no old color values remain.
environment_constraints: No build system. Static HTML/CSS. Push via github power tools only (push_to_remote).
key_patterns: CSS variables defined in :root and html.dark blocks in style.css. Pages use inline <style> blocks for page-specific CSS. HTML pages follow consistent structure with sections, containers, and fade-up animations.
directory_structure: public/ contains index.html, assets/ (style.css), pages/ (individual HTML pages). Source/ contains reference images.
